question: Quels sont les 5 clients qui ont dépensé le plus en 2026 ?
sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(p.price * o.quantity), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2026' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5

question: Donne-moi le chiffre d'affaires total par mois.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(p.price * o.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Quelle catégorie génère le plus de chiffre d'affaires en 2026 ?
sql: SELECT p.category FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2026' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(p.price * o.quantity) DESC, p.category LIMIT 1

question: Combien de commandes payées avons-nous par ville ?
sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY paid_orders DESC, c.city

question: Quel est le panier moyen des commandes payées en 2026 ?
sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT o.id, SUM(p.price * o.quantity) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2026' GROUP BY o.id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS average_basket FROM totals

question: Quels clients n'ont encore passé aucune commande ?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.name

question: Classe les produits par chiffre d'affaires dans chaque catégorie.
sql: WITH revenue AS (SELECT p.id, p.category, p.name, SUM(p.price * o.quantity) AS amount FROM products p JOIN orders o ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name) SELECT category, name, amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY amount DESC, id) AS rank FROM revenue ORDER BY category, rank

question: Compare le nombre de commandes payées et annulées.
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled FROM orders

question: Affiche les clients puis supprime leurs commandes.
sql: SELECT * FROM customers; DELETE FROM orders
